o.text: From Proto-Turkic *agsa- (“to hobble, limp”). Cognate with Turkish aksamak, Crimean Tatar aqsamaq, etc.
Borrowed from Russian валю́та (valjúta), Italian valuta (“currency”), from Latin valeō (“to be worth”).
Borrowed from Russian фармакология (farmakologija). By surface analysis, farmako- + -logiya.
